violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: All kitchenware/tableware washed I dishmachine which was observed to have a chlorine concentration less than 50 ppm..
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Sanitize all kitchenware and tableware in the three vat sink after washing in the dishmachine until the dishmachine is restored to fully functional condition.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Do not store any food in the walk-in freezer until it is restored to fully functional condition - able to maintain food solidly frozen.
